args.name: ops
args.inactive_reason: Operation table metadata and pointer bits are fixed; the float32 views behind its typed pointers remain active.

indirect_activity.active: all continuous float32 source and destination views, plus continuous scalar fill values traced to active consuming reads
indirect_activity.inactive: integer views and literal fixed fill values
indirect_activity.alias: one tangent or adjoint allocation per captured backing allocation; preserve offsets and repeated source pointers
indirect_activity.fill_provenance: A captured fill word alone does not identify its producer. The binder must trace each continuous fill to its original scalar, supply one pointer per operation, and preserve scalar aliases. For example resident_ruc_rrfs.py:327-328 fills dt from self._dt, which is selected from call.dt at :449. Only a fixed literal or a ledger-inactive consuming read has a null scalar derivative pointer.

refusal.prerequisite: checked table layout, extent and capacity; written destination views disjoint from each other and from all source views, as in glue_plan.py:209-226; scalar derivative slots are disjoint from written output slots and scalar aliases are preserved

affine_reason: For fixed plan metadata the forward is a linear copy, broadcast or scalar fill in the active float32 arguments plus fixed fills; integer views and indices are fixed.
workspace: 32*sum(op.count) bytes, zero initialized; 16-byte buckets, capacity twice the total captured element count. Size and integer overflow checked at bind time.

args.description: Per operation, pointer to the tangent of its traced active float32 fill scalar, or null if fixed/integer; repeated scalar producers share a pointer.
Per operation, pointer to the cotangent of its traced active float32 fill scalar, or null if fixed/integer; repeated scalar producers share a pointer.

integration_note: Provisional and unproved: pointer capture mirror, active fill provenance, per-operation scalar pointer arrays and dynamic workspace require runner-ext/binder adoption. A captured fill word is not sufficient to reconstruct active scalar provenance.
